description: Find related medications by RxCUI — brands, generics, ingredients, and dose forms. Maps between brand and generic alternatives. Use to compare drug options.

rxcui.description: RxNorm concept ID, or a drug name (e.g. "aspirin") — resolved to an RxCUI automatically.

tty.description: Optional term type filter: BN (brand name), IN (ingredient), SBD (semantic branded drug), SCD (semantic clinical drug), GPCK (generic pack), BPCK (branded pack); other RxNorm term types such as PIN, MIN, DF and DFG also work. For several, separate them with a comma, a plus or a space — "BN,SBD", "BN+SBD" and "BN SBD" are all accepted and equivalent. Case does not matter. Omit for the default set (IN, BN, SBD, SCD, GPCK, BPCK).

name: rxnorm_related

related_groups.description: Groups of related drug concepts by term type

title: Rxnorm Related
